#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
SOURCE=/srv/data
SNAP_ROOT=/srv/.snapshots/data
NAME=${1:-manual-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}
case "$NAME" in
  ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*)
    printf 'invalid snapshot name: %s\n' "$NAME" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
install -d -m 0755 "$SOURCE"
install -d -m 0700 "$SNAP_ROOT"
DEST="$SNAP_ROOT/$NAME"
if [ -e "$DEST" ]; then
  printf 'snapshot already exists: %s\n' "$DEST" >&2
  exit 3
fi
TMP="$SNAP_ROOT/.$NAME.partial.$$"
cleanup() {
  if [ -d "$TMP" ]; then
    rm -rf -- "$TMP"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -m 0700 "$TMP"
PREVIOUS=$(ls -1dt "$SNAP_ROOT"/* 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
if [ -n "$PREVIOUS" ] && [ -d "$PREVIOUS" ]; then
  rsync -aHA --numeric-ids --delete --link-dest="$PREVIOUS" "$SOURCE/" "$TMP/"
else
  rsync -aHA --numeric-ids --delete "$SOURCE/" "$TMP/"
fi
sync
mv "$TMP" "$DEST"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' "$DEST"
ANTRIEB_SNAPSHOT_EOF
cat > /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-restore <<'ANTRIEB_RESTORE_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
SNAP_ROOT=/srv/.snapshots/data
SOURCE=/srv/data
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  printf 'usage: %s SNAPSHOT_NAME\n' "$0" >&2
  exit 2
fi
NAME=$1
case "$NAME" in
  ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*)
    printf 'invalid snapshot name: %s\n' "$NAME" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
SNAPSHOT="$SNAP_ROOT/$NAME"
if [ ! -d "$SNAPSHOT" ]; then
  printf 'snapshot not found: %s\n' "$SNAPSHOT" >&2
  exit 3
fi
install -d -m 0755 "$SOURCE"
SAFETY_NAME="pre-restore-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-snapshot "$SAFETY_NAME" >/dev/null
rsync -aHA --numeric-ids --delete "$SNAPSHOT/" "$SOURCE/"
sync
DIFF=$(rsync -aHAcni --numeric-ids --delete "$SNAPSHOT/" "$SOURCE/")
if [ -n "$DIFF" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$DIFF" >&2
  printf 'restore verification failed\n' >&2
  exit 4
fi
printf 'restored=%s safety_snapshot=%s/%s\n' "$SNAPSHOT" "$SNAP_ROOT" "$SAFETY_NAME"
ANTRIEB_RESTORE_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-snapshot /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-restore
cat > /etc/cron.d/srv-data-snapshot <<'ANTRIEB_CRON_EOF'
# Daily point-in-time snapshot of /srv/data; root-only storage.
17 2 * * * root /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-snapshot auto-$(date -u +\%Y\%m\%dT\%H\%M\%SZ) >/dev/null 2>&1
ANTRIEB_CRON_EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/cron.d/srv-data-snapshot
printf 'installed snapshot tooling and daily schedule\n'
ls -l /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-snapshot /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-restore /etc/cron.d/srv-data-snapshot
